repositories.name: i-have-adhd
repositories.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
repositories.summary: 这是一个面向编程助手的技能插件，让 AI 输出先给行动、步骤编号、结尾只留一个下一步，避免把答案埋在冗长解释里。

repositories.name: gods-eye-view
repositories.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repositories.summary: 一个在浏览器中运行的开源三维地球情报模拟器，可实时追踪飞机、船舶、卫星等公开数据。

repositories.name: iloader
repositories.summary: iloader 是一款用 TypeScript 开发的用户友好侧载工具，可安装 SideStore 等应用并自动导入配对文件。

repositories.name: DeskcommCRM
repositories.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
repositories.summary: DeskcommCRM 是一款开源、可自托管的 AI 销售 CRM，内置 AI 智能体并通过 WhatsApp 接待、筛选和促成销售，面向以聊天成交的企业。

repositories.name: PI-Desktop
repositories.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repositories.summary: PI-Desktop 是一个本地优先的 AI 编程智能体桌面工作区，基于 Electron 与 Rust 核心，可接入自有模型并安装插件扩展。

repositories.name: armorpaint
repositories.summary: ArmorPaint 是一款用于 3D PBR 纹理绘制的软件，此仓库面向开发者提供其源代码。

repositories.name: CloddsBot
repositories.description: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
repositories.summary: CloddsBot 是一个基于 Claude 的开源自主 AI 交易代理，可跨预测市场、加密货币、DeFi 和永续合约等平台自动扫描机会、执行交易并管理风险。

repositories.name: llm_wiki
repositories.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repositories.summary: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用大模型自动把文档整理成结构化、互相链接的持久化知识库，替代传统 RAG 检索方式。

repositories.name: superpowers
repositories.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repositories.summary: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的软件开发方法论，通过可组合技能和初始指令，引导代理在编码前进行头脑风暴、测试驱动开发等系统化流程。

repositories.name: Sonarr
repositories.description: Smart PVR for newsgroup and bittorrent users.
repositories.summary: Sonarr 是一款面向 Usenet 和 BitTorrent 用户的 PVR 工具，可监控剧集更新、自动下载、整理和重命名，并在出现更高画质时自动升级。

repositories.name: MathModelAgent
repositories.description: 🤖📐专为数学建模设计的 Agent & skills ,自动完成数学建模，生成一份完整的可以直接提交的论文。 An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling ,Automatically complete mathmodel and generate a complete paper ready for submission.
repositories.summary: MathModelAgent 是面向数学建模竞赛的自动化工具，可分析问题、编写代码并生成格式完整的可提交论文。

repositories.name: OpenFlux
repositories.description: Network stack research tool. TCP tunnel with pluggable transports.
repositories.summary: OpenFlux 是一个用 Go 编写的网络协议栈研究工具，实现带可插拔传输层的 TCP 隧道，客户端提供 SOCKS5 代理，经出口节点转发流量。

repositories.name: hyperresearch
repositories.description: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
repositories.summary: Hyperresearch 是一个由智能体驱动的深度研究工具，可将 Claude Code 变成研究代理，自动收集、检索并综合网络资料，生成带来源溯源的报告，并存入可持久搜索的知识库。

repositories.name: OpenResearch
repositories.description: Run parallel research agents with any model
repositories.summary: OpenResearch 是一个本地优先的研究智能体工作区，可驱动 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 并行开展文献调研、假设验证与实验，并记录可复现的实验过程。

repositories.name: spec-kit
repositories.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repositories.summary: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的工具包，帮助开发者用任意 AI 编码代理按规范驱动开发流程，先定义需求再实现软件。

repositories.name: editor
repositories.description: Open-source 3D architectural editor with a local CLI, MCP tools, and practical workflows for humans and AI agents.
repositories.summary: Pascal Editor 是一个开源本地优先的 3D 建筑编辑器，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，可在浏览器或 CLI 中运行，并通过 MCP 连接 AI 智能体。
